purpose: Preserve the immutable registry proof and admit a same-run private containerd image archive as a verified recovery baseline for the legacy API image.

composeInputEvidence.purpose: Preserve the exact order of repeated ordinary Compose inputs and retain the original limit of sixteen distinct protected files. Keep managed override position and effective model checks.

composeReferenceEvidence.purpose: Admit only bounded block anchor definitions and whole mapping-value aliases. Keep YAML merge keys, indirect external files, nested references and other unsupported syntax closed.

composeInlineAnchorEvidence.purpose: Admit a bounded literal scalar after a mapping-value anchor on the same line. Continue rejecting external file aliases, malformed reference positions and multiline anchor scalars.

composeInlineInterpolationEvidence.purpose: Admit bounded Compose variable substitutions in an inline anchored plain scalar while preserving the external-input, renderer equality and rollback guards.

composeSquareBracketEvidence.purpose: Admit bounded literal bracketed values and single-line scalar lists while preserving the external-input, renderer equality and rollback guards.

composeInlineEnvFileEvidence.purpose: Admit a closed single-line list of literal env_file paths and capture every listed file before rendering, with existing protected path, model equality and rollback checks.

siblingMountOrderEvidence.purpose: Canonicalize the inspection order of complete sibling mount records. Every mount value and multiplicity still participates in the comparison.

reconciledLedgerHistoryEvidence.purpose: Recognize the exact four reconciled W1 ledger rows on an existing database with the canonical corrective migration. Keep fresh-ledger, catalog, privilege, and before/after history comparisons.

releaseFailureDiagnosticsEvidence.purpose: Preserve only closed errors from the exact pinned database-binding primitive and report a closed failure stage. This changes diagnostics, not release eligibility or execution order.

historicalReceipt.qualification: The receipt proves no armed API image transition; its broad runtime state does not prove absence of journal, archive or backup preparation.

reproducedDefect.before: Actual pinned bind() raises BindingError POSTGRES_CONFIGURATION for synthetic PG_MAJOR=15; unchanged Host.database/release() erases it to EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE.
reproducedDefect.after: The same synthetic read-only boundary yields BINDING_DEFAULT_POSTGRES_CONFIGURATION and BASELINE_DATABASE, before reservation or API mutation.
reproducedDefect.qualification: Synthetic regression with fake runtime and external processes forbidden. It does not assert the production PostgreSQL version or historical host cause.
